templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from overview-with-inset by the note-writer: two side-by-side mechanism panels (its own corpus label control-data) with a small embedded throughput-vs-load chart, not a zoom of a region drawn elsewhere in the same figure.
templates.what_to_learn: The transferable move is control-data's: mark both places a request can be dropped in matching red, feed the resulting failure path into one dashed arrow, and let a small embedded performance chart justify the credit-pool adjustment instead of asserting it, but legend the resource icons this exemplar leaves unexplained.

templates.why_chosen: Two labelled red Drop points (before CPU processing, at mutex acquisition) merge into one dashed failure arrow, while a double-headed arrow closes a compact feedback loop driven by an inset throughput-vs-load chart.
templates.what_to_learn: Embed a small inset chart (throughput vs load) beside the arrow it drives so the feedback signal is visible, not just implied, and give every drop point its own icon; route each to its own arrow rather than merging two distinct drop points into one dashed line, which here can read as a single point.
